records.method: protocol demonstration: OSAM field values scored through the published curves with DEEP's interpolator, banded, compared with the crews' capacity calls
records.outcome: no per-curve support claimed: chance-corrected agreement at or below zero on every comparable pair, curves read softer than the crews on width-to-depth ratio and substrate (the best-available offset)
excluded_pair: not comparable: no shippable scoring curve in this region (collapsed lower quartile, fallback excluded from the bundle)

dataset_provenance.dataset: Ohio Stream Assessment Method summary data (OSAM)
dataset_provenance.site_selection: every site whose id starts with ECBP (inside ecoregion 55)
dataset_provenance.survey_years: INFORMATION REQUIRED (not recorded in the workbook)
dataset_provenance.capacity_call_derivation: INFORMATION REQUIRED: the workbook maps each measured variable to the function its call belongs to, so the calls may be rubric-derived from the compared indicators

independence.sites: independent (no OSAM site within 8 km of an NRSA development site)
independence.variables: different measurement methods per pair (documented in the crosswalk)

design_approval.gate: Phase 6 design gate, before any conclusion was drawn
design_approval.measures: band agreement at the 0.39 and 0.69 breaks; Phase 8 recast added chance expectations, linear-weighted kappa, Spearman correlation with sign, per-site aggregation, permutation p
design_approval.acceptance_threshold: none claimed at 16 and 4 sites; the only decision rule was below-chance agreement or a systematically opposite direction
design_approval.recast: Phase 8 (adversarial review VAL-1, VAL-2, STAT-11): reported as a protocol demonstration with no per-curve support

history.note: Exploratory field comparison only; not validation
